plugins.name: stable-baseline
plugins.description: Create and maintain living docs, diagrams, infographics, and whiteboards in your Stable Baseline workspace, and search your shared knowledge graph, all from Claude Code.

skills.name: sb-create-diagram
skills.description: Generate and insert a diagram into an existing Stable Baseline document. Use when user wants to create a diagram, add a diagram, insert a chart, or run sb-create-diagram.
skills.description_zh: 生成图示并插入已有 Stable Baseline 文档，适用于添加图、图表或调用 sb-create-diagram。

skills.name: sb-create-doc
skills.description: Create a new Stable Baseline document (CDMD) with optional follow-up diagram/image insertion. Use when user wants to create a document, write docs, or run sb-create-doc.
skills.description_zh: 创建新的 Stable Baseline CDMD 文档，可后续插入图示或图片。

skills.name: sb-create-whiteboard
skills.description: Create a Stable Baseline whiteboard, either by hand (stencils, architecture icons, sticky notes, embedded diagrams, freedraw) or with the premium AI multi-agent designer. Use when user wants to create a whiteboard, design a board, sketch an architecture or flow visually, or run sb-create-whiteboard.
headings: A) AI multi-agent design (premium, fastest for a polished board)
skills.description_zh: 创建 Stable Baseline 白板，可手动使用模板、架构图标、便签、嵌入图和自由绘制，或使用付费 AI 多智能体设计，适用于架构流程草图及白板需求。

skills.name: sb-edit-doc
skills.description: Edit an existing Stable Baseline document using line-based patches or bulk find-and-replace, with proper optimistic locking. Use when user wants to edit a document, update docs, or run sb-edit-doc.
skills.description_zh: 通过逐行补丁或批量查找替换编辑已有 Stable Baseline 文档，采用正确的乐观锁。

skills.name: sb-edit-whiteboard
skills.description: Update an existing Stable Baseline whiteboard: add, move, restyle, or remove elements, embed diagrams or images, and re-render. Use when user wants to edit a whiteboard, update a board, change something on a board, or run sb-edit-whiteboard.
skills.description_zh: 修改已有 Stable Baseline 白板，添加移动改样式或移除元素、嵌入图示图片并重新渲染。

skills.name: sb-manage-data
skills.description: Upload, reference, and manage data files (CSV, JSON, TSV) for Vega/Vega-Lite diagrams in a Stable Baseline document. Use when user wants to upload data files, create charts with data, or run sb-manage-data.
headings: Uploading a data file and creating a Vega diagram
Multiple data files in one diagram
skills.description_zh: 上传、引用和管理 CSV、JSON、TSV 数据文件，用于 Stable Baseline 文档中的 Vega/Vega-Lite 图表。

skills.name: sb-manage-images
skills.description: Upload, insert, update, or delete images in a Stable Baseline document using the upload-session flow. Use when user wants to manage images, add screenshots, or run sb-manage-images.
skills.description_zh: 通过上传会话流程上传、插入、更新或删除 Stable Baseline 文档图片，适用于截图等媒体管理。

skills.name: sb-search
skills.description: Search the Stable Baseline knowledge graph (the shared company brain) to find documents, answer questions, surface related content, and look up entities across the workspace. Use when user wants to search docs, ask the company brain, find related documents, or run sb-search.
headings: Stable Baseline — Search the Knowledge Graph
skills.description_zh: 搜索 Stable Baseline 公司共享知识图谱，查找文档、实体及相关内容并回答问题。

skills.name: sb-setup
skills.description: Onboard a repository into Stable Baseline: discover IDs, analyse the repo, create a bespoke documentation structure, and augment AGENTS.md with sync rules. Use when user wants to set up Stable Baseline, onboard a project, generate initial documentation, or run sb-setup.
skills.description_zh: 将仓库接入 Stable Baseline，发现编号、分析代码库、创建定制文档结构，并向 AGENTS.md 加入同步规则。

skills.name: sb-sync
skills.description: Generate or update the Stable Baseline section in AGENTS.md for cross-IDE auto-sync. Preserves all existing AGENTS.md content. Use when user wants to sync AGENTS.md, regenerate sync rules, or run sb-sync.
skills.description_zh: 生成更新 AGENTS.md 中 Stable Baseline 同步段，支持跨 IDE 自动同步，保留原有全部内容。

skills.name: sb-update
skills.description: Update Stable Baseline documentation with changes, decisions, and knowledge from the current conversation. Use mid-conversation when architectural changes, key decisions, or important implementation details need to be captured. Use when user says sb-update, update docs, sync docs, or capture changes.
skills.description_zh: 把当前对话中的架构变更、关键决策和实施知识更新到 Stable Baseline 文档，适用于会话中捕获变化和同步文档。
